prompt: Create one sophisticated contemporary flat illustration asset for Sela, an Indonesian personal wellbeing application. This is a standalone illustration, not a UI or screenshot, no text anywhere, no words, no branding. Transparent background. Full composition visible with margins. Landscape 4:3 composition: an adult person with dark hair and an oversized saturated yellow shirt sits comfortably sideways on a low deep navy curved bench, holding an open white notebook. Behind the bench is one large sculptural vermilion-red arch and a single oversize cobalt leaf; a simple porcelain-white circle rests at the base. It should feel like an art-directed international cultural festival poster illustration: confident cut-paper shapes, concise adult figure, beautiful negative spaces, almost vector-flat color with minimal purposeful shading, no distressed texture, no grain, no gradients, no outline doodles. Palette strictly navy #14213D, saturated yellow #F6CF42, white, scarlet #D74935, and small cobalt. No decorative charts, no trophies, no score, no face closeup, no sad expression, no health symbols, no stethoscope. The notebook and seated posture convey unhurried private writing. The asset must work on white, pale yellow, and navy product backgrounds; entire illustration contained within the frame.
